judgements.reason: GrothendieckEulerForms already has exact structures, all four K0 groups, the resolution theorem, the Cartan map for rings, Ext-Euler descent and numerical quotients; it still needs bounded-complex comparisons, Cartan-matrix bases and a sesquilinear chi_q. NumberFieldArithmetic still needs Dedekind's theorem, the whole completion dictionary (semilocal decomposition, D_Q = Gal(L_w/K_v), localisation of the different) and global ramification groups with the different-exponent formula, on top of an unbuilt local lower-filtration theory.

NumberFieldArithmetic's remaining gap is broad but classical: the completion dictionary, ramification groups with the imported local Hilbert different formula, Dedekind's theorem and unit certificates, with much of Layers 1-4 already in Tau Ceti. Chebotarev, whose Artin-symbol inputs are built, still needs deeper stacked analysis: ray-class characters with per-class ideal counting and a power-saving error, continuation and 1-line nonvanishing of cyclotomic Hecke L-series, the full Wiener-Ikehara theorem and density calculus, then its crossing, abelian, general and weighted Tauberian layers.

Chebotarev builds on existing Artin symbols, Dirichlet-series and Euler-product infrastructure and part of Wiener-Ikehara; it needs Hecke-character analysis plus crossing layers. ColemanPowerSeries rests on an entirely unbuilt stack (completed group rings, pseudo-measures and Iwasawa structure theory, the Kubota-Leopoldt pseudo-measure, the cyclotomic-unit index formula) before its own five layers: the Coleman norm operator, the Coleman map, the exact sequences and Theorem 12.23.

FuchsianOrbifolds needs its own geometric layers (orbifold charts, the Poincare polygon theorem with Dirichlet polygons, cusp compactification, degree theory) plus borrowed CW Euler-characteristic and triangulation topology for Riemann-Hurwitz. ColemanPowerSeries needs a somewhat larger and deeper arithmetic stack that is entirely unbuilt: Iwasawa algebras with the structure theorem and determinants, the Kubota-Leopoldt pseudo-measure and the cyclotomic-unit index formula (plus recorded p-adic distribution and Tate-thesis inputs), under the Coleman norm operator, Coleman map and Iwasawa's local-unit theorem.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra is self-contained commutative and derived algebra on a strong Mathlib base (regular sequences, Rees depth, projective dimension, derived categories, spectral sequences); it needs Schlessinger, Cohen-Macaulay/Auslander-Buchsbaum, patching, perfect complexes and Calegari-Geraghty patching. FuchsianOrbifolds needs more: its almost unbuilt geometry (orbifold quotient surfaces, the Poincare polygon theorem and Dirichlet polygons, cusps and compactification, degree theory) plus an unbuilt algebraic-topology stack (excision, cellular homology, CW Euler characteristic, smooth triangulation) for Riemann-Hurwitz.

Both are self-contained algebra, but DGAInfinity has twelve heavily stacked layers still to build on top of its landed sign, coalgebra and A-infinity definitions: A-infinity categories and modules, Kadeishvili transfer, bar-cobar, twisted complexes and Perf, derived Morita theory, Drinfeld quotients, Hochschild deformation theory, Calabi-Yau completions and HRR, Koszul duality. DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra's Schlessinger, Cohen-Macaulay, patching and perfect-complex layers are fewer and rest on more existing Mathlib commutative algebra.

DGAInfinity's missing theory is large but internal homological algebra. SelmerIwasawaCohomology takes an unbuilt arithmetic stack from other roadmaps: Poitou-Tate and compact-coefficient cohomology (which need local and global class field theory), period rings and Bloch-Kato exponentials, Iwasawa algebras, and the Iwasawa modules X and Y through IntegralIwasawaTheory L1, which includes all of ColemanPowerSeries. Selmer complexes, Iwasawa cohomology and control theorems come on top.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology needs Galois cohomology and duality, period rings and Iwasawa theory (about 57 recorded upstream stages). AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations needs modular and Shimura curves over Z with Jacobians and the Eichler-Shimura relation, etale cohomology with Weil I/II, geometric p-adic comparison theorems, local Langlands and global Jacquet-Langlands for GL2 (about 335 upstream stages) before its six layers.

LanglandsParameterStacks needs infinity-categorical foundations, split reductive groups over Z with good-filtration representation theory, condensed/solid inputs and the FS VIII parameter-stack theory. AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations' recorded closure already contains most of those foundations (EnhancedDerivedSheaves, ReductiveGroupsPartII) and adds the arithmetic geometry of modular and Shimura curves, etale cohomology with Weil II, p-adic comparison theorems and GL2 automorphic transfer.

OrdinaryAutomorphicFormsAndModularityLifting consumes all of AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations (Shimura-curve and modular-curve cohomology, Weil II, p-adic comparison, Jacquet-Langlands). On top it needs Hida theory, Kisin's potentially semistable deformation rings, Taylor-Wiles primes and patching before ordinary R=T and Skinner-Wiles. LanglandsParameterStacks' infinity-categorical, reductive-group and parameter-stack theory is smaller, and most of its foundations also lie in Ordinary's closure.

Beyond elementary polylogarithms, Polylogarithms needs a huge unbuilt K-theoretic stack: Quillen/Waldhausen K-theory, Suslin's K3 and Bloch groups, Borel's regulator theorem, and motivic cohomology with the motivic spectral sequence (about 171 recorded upstream stages). OrdinaryAutomorphicFormsAndModularityLifting stacks more (about 394 stages): all of AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations (etale cohomology with Weil II, p-adic comparison, Shimura curves, Jacquet-Langlands) plus Hida theory, Kisin deformation rings and patching.

Polylogarithms' K-theory, Borel-regulator and motivic-cohomology prerequisites are vast. PotentialModularityAndCompatibleSystems contains the whole Ordinary/AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations closure and adds Kisin-style GL2 modularity lifting, Langlands-Tunnell and automorphic induction, twisted Hilbert-Blumenthal moduli and Moret-Bailly's theorem (about 429 upstream stages), before its own potential-modularity and compatible-system layers.

NoncommutativeAndEquivariantIwasawa needs Lambda(G) theory, K1 and SK1, Poitou-Tate, and the abelian main conjecture via Deligne-Ribet and integral Brumer-Stark (which needs Hilbert modular Galois representations). PotentialModularityAndCompatibleSystems contains all of AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations and OrdinaryAutomorphicForms, the complete GL2 modularity-lifting and deformation theory, Langlands-Tunnell and Moret-Bailly; it is a strictly larger and deeper stack.

LanglandsParameterStacks needs infinity-categorical foundations, split reductive groups over Z with Weyl modules and good filtrations, condensed/solid inputs and FS VIII (its recorded diamond/perfectoid closure is mostly inflation through VS2). NoncommutativeAndEquivariantIwasawa's recorded closure carries comparable derived foundations and adds much more arithmetic: class field theory and Poitou-Tate, Selmer and Iwasawa complexes, Deligne-Ribet p-adic L-functions, integral Brumer-Stark (itself needing Hilbert modular Galois representations) and Kurihara's main conjecture, under Lazard-type Lambda(G) theory, K1 and SK1, and Kakde's proof.

GrothendieckEulerForms has most of its spine landed and lacks only bounded-complex comparisons, general resolving subcategories, Cartan-matrix bases and the sesquilinear q-Euler form, with the needed Krull-Schmidt and projective-cover inputs already in Tau Ceti. DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra has nothing of its own built: complete local coefficient categories, Schlessinger, Cohen-Macaulay/Auslander-Buchsbaum and complete-intersection criteria, patching, perfect complexes with derived completion and the Tor spectral sequence, and Calegari-Geraghty patching all remain.

Polylogarithms needs higher K-theory, Suslin's K3/Bloch-group theorem, Borel's regulator theorem and higher Chow groups with the motivic spectral sequence; its larger recorded closure (about 171 stages) is partly inflated by the norm-residue chain, which enters only through a readiness checkpoint. NoncommutativeAndEquivariantIwasawa needs class field theory and Poitou-Tate, Selmer/Iwasawa complexes, Deligne-Ribet p-adic L-functions and Kurihara's main conjecture via integral Brumer-Stark, which also requires Galois representations of Hilbert modular forms not recorded as an edge. It adds Lazard-type Lambda(G) theory, K1/SK1 and Kakde's proof, which makes it slightly farther.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology's supplier IntegralIwasawaTheory L1 requires ColemanPowerSeries L4, so all of Coleman's missing theory (Iwasawa algebras, Kubota-Leopoldt, the Coleman map, cyclotomic-unit index) lies inside Selmer's. Selmer adds compact-coefficient cohomology and Poitou-Tate (needing class field theory), period rings and Bloch-Kato exponentials, and its own Selmer-complex, Iwasawa-cohomology and control layers.

Chebotarev's remaining work is ray-class counting and characters, Hecke L-series continuation and nonvanishing, the full Wiener-Ikehara theorem and crossing layers, on a well-advanced base: Artin symbols, the Frobenius prime-set carrier, Euler products and the auxiliary-prime and fixed-field machinery. FuchsianOrbifolds has only begun Layer 0. It still needs the orbifold quotient Riemann surface, the Poincare polygon theorem and Dirichlet polygons, cusp compactification and degree theory, plus borrowed unbuilt topology (excision, cellular homology, CW Euler characteristic, smooth triangulation) for Riemann-Hurwitz.

PotentialModularityAndCompatibleSystems consumes AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations R19.6, and hence all of its missing theory, directly and through OrdinaryAutomorphicForms. It adds Hida and Kisin deformation theory, GL2 modularity lifting, Langlands-Tunnell and automorphic induction, twisted Hilbert-Blumenthal moduli with Moret-Bailly, and its own potential-modularity and compatible-system layers.

DGAInfinity's gap (A-infinity categories, minimal models, derived Morita theory, DG quotients, Hochschild and Calabi-Yau theory, Koszul duality) is large but internal algebra on landed foundations. OrdinaryAutomorphicFormsAndModularityLifting needs all of AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations (modular and Shimura curves, etale cohomology with Weil II, p-adic comparison, Jacquet-Langlands) plus Hida theory, deformation rings and patching (about 394 upstream stages).

NumberFieldArithmetic's remaining theory is classical and about half built: the completion dictionary, local and global ramification groups with Hilbert's different formula, Dedekind's theorem and unit certificates. ColemanPowerSeries needs an entirely unbuilt Iwasawa-theoretic stack (completed group rings, pseudo-measures, the structure theorem, Kubota-Leopoldt, the cyclotomic-unit index formula) under five unbuilt layers of Coleman power-series theory.

GrothendieckEulerForms has its categorical spine landed and lacks only bounded-complex K0 comparisons, general resolving subcategories, Cartan-matrix bases and the sesquilinear q-Euler form. Chebotarev still needs ray-class characters and per-class ideal counting, Hecke L-series continuation and nonvanishing, the full Wiener-Ikehara theorem, and eight untouched density, crossing and Tauberian layers.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology needs Galois duality (with class field theory), period rings and Iwasawa theory including Coleman's (about 57 upstream stages). OrdinaryAutomorphicFormsAndModularityLifting needs all of AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations (modular and Shimura curves, etale cohomology with Weil II, p-adic comparison, Jacquet-Langlands) plus Hida theory, Kisin deformation rings and patching (about 394 stages). Its recorded closure even includes Selmer L0-L2.

NumberFieldArithmetic still needs the completion dictionary, local ramification groups with Hilbert's different formula, global ramification groups, Dedekind's theorem and unit certificates, but its Layers 1-4 and the completion and local-field instances are largely in Tau Ceti. DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra has nothing of its own built and must stack complete local coefficient categories, Schlessinger, Cohen-Macaulay/Auslander-Buchsbaum, patching and support theory, then perfect complexes, derived completion, the Tor spectral sequence and Calegari-Geraghty derived patching.
